Game Overview

Block Blast Streak is a block game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Block Blast Streak doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Block Blast Streak?

Block Blast Streak is a free block game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Block Blast Streak free to play?

Yes, Block Blast Streak is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
